domain.description: Domain name to append to DNS queries (e.g., 'example.com'). Optional.

expand_hosts.description: Expand short hostnames to FQDN using the domain setting.

no_resolv.description: Do not read /etc/resolv.conf or any other file for upstream DNS servers.

no_poll.description: Do not poll /etc/resolv.conf for changes (requires no-resolv).

interface.description: Only listen on the specified interface (e.g., 'eth0'). Conflicts with 'except-interface'.

except_interface.description: Listen on all interfaces except the specified one (e.g., 'lo').

bind_interfaces.description: Bind only to interfaces with configured addresses (implied by 'bind-dynamic' or modern dnsmasq).

bind_dynamic.description: Use bind-dynamic to avoid blocking on interface up/down events.

listen_address.description: Listen only on the specified IPv4 address (e.g., '127.0.0.1'). Deprecated — prefer 'listen_addresses'.

listen_addresses.description: List of IPv4 addresses to listen on. Always include at least 127.0.0.1 for local queries.

no_dhcp_interface.description: Disable DHCP on the specified interface (e.g., 'eth0').

dhcp_pools.description: List of DHCP address pools to serve.

netmask.description: Netmask or CIDR prefix length (e.g., '255.255.255.0' or '24'). Optional.

dns.description: List of DNS server IPs to advertise (e.g., ['192.168.1.1', '8.8.8.8']).

dns_option.description: Custom DHCP option number/name for DNS (e.g., 'option6:dns-server' for IPv6).

ntp.description: List of NTP servers to advertise.

static_leases.description: List of static DHCP assignments (MAC → IP).

lease_time.description: Optional lease duration for this host (e.g., '1w', 'infinite').

server.description: Single upstream DNS server IP (deprecated — prefer 'servers').

servers.description: List of upstream DNS servers to forward queries to.

items.description: IPv4 or IPv6 address of upstream DNS server. May include interface for split-DNS (e.g., '8.8.8.8#eth0').

dnssec.description: Enable DNSSEC validation of upstream responses.

dnssec_check_valid.description: Check for DNSSEC validation status (requires dnssec).

dns_rewrite_rules.description: DNS rewrite rules (e.g., to block domains by redirect).

log_queries.description: Log all DNS queries (to syslog). Useful for debugging.

cache_size.description: Number of DNS queries to cache. 0 disables caching.

min_cache_ttl.description: Minimum TTL (seconds) for cached entries (overrides short TTLs).

max_cache_ttl.description: Maximum TTL (seconds) for cached entries (overrides long TTLs).

tftp_root.description: Directory to serve via TFTP (requires enable-tftp).

tftp_no_fail.description: Do not fail if TFTP request file is not found.

extra_lines.description: List of arbitrary additional config lines (passed through literally). Use sparingly.
